about.title: Data, models, and questions that matter.
paragraphs: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (May peace be upon you).

I am K M Mubin, a curious learner and aspiring researcher from Dhaka, Bangladesh. You can call me Mubin. I am currently pursuing a B.Sc. in Data Science at the American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB). My main interests lie in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, NLP, LLMs, Information Retrieval, and developing technology that can create meaningful real-world impact.

My journey in Data Science has been shaped by continuous learning, experimentation, and persistence. Through university clubs, event organizing, the Duke of Edinburgh’s programme, and AIESEC, I have developed my leadership, teamwork, and communication skills. At the same time, competitions, academic projects, and research experiences have taught me how to keep improving even when results do not come immediately.

I am particularly interested in NLP, LLM evaluation, information retrieval, multilingual and low-resource language technologies, ML interpretability, and AI for social good. I enjoy experimenting with newly released AI models, running models locally, exploring automation, and working on projects that combine data analysis, modeling, visualization, interpretation, and practical applications.

Research is becoming an important part of my journey. I enjoy asking why a method works, why it fails, and how different approaches can be compared more carefully. While I am still developing as a researcher, I want to contribute work that is useful, reproducible, and capable of solving meaningful problems.

Beyond technology, I enjoy learning about Psychology, History, Geopolitics, Theology, and other areas that help me understand people and the world from different perspectives. I believe learning never really stops, and I try to treat every experience, whether successful or difficult, as an opportunity to become a better version of myself.

focusAreas.title: Seek Knowledge from Experts
focusAreas.description: Islam encourages asking those with knowledge when we are unsure, as stated in the Quran: “So ask the people of the message if you do not know” (21:7). This keeps answers grounded in evidence rather than opinion.

focusAreas.title: Ask for Lived Experience
focusAreas.description: Before diving into complex theology, I use open questions such as “Can you share a story that explains what this teaching means to you?” Stories build connection and clarify context through personal experience.

focusAreas.title: Practice Critical Thinking and Mercy
focusAreas.description: Instead of issuing judgments, I try to understand the specific circumstances and capacities involved. Questions can guide people with mercy, making the “why” and “how” clearer and more compassionate.

focusAreas.title: Establish Consent and Focus on Basics
focusAreas.description: I start with permission and curiosity. When I do not know an answer, I explain the core worldview first, say “I don’t know,” and commit to finding the answer rather than guessing.

projects.title: Climate impact on AUS rice yield
projects.description: A research-led analysis of how climate variability affects AUS rice yield in Bangladesh across long-term historical data from 1969 to 2023.
details: Integrated and cleaned long-term climate and agricultural data.
Combined econometric modeling with a Random Forest workflow.
Used satellite data to improve model performance and interpret feature importance.

projects.title: Air pollution awareness study
projects.description: A KAP survey analysis exploring the relationship between knowledge, attitude, and protective behavior around air pollution.
details: Prepared and explored survey data with reproducible Python notebooks.
Applied statistical modeling to test relationships between behavioral factors.
Designed visuals that make the research findings easier to discuss.

projects.title: Spotlight Attires insights
projects.description: A real-world business analysis project focused on turning company data into practical insights for better decisions.
details: Structured the analysis around business questions rather than isolated charts.
Explored performance patterns, trends, and opportunities in company data.
Built a clear analysis narrative with recommendations for stakeholders.

projects.title: AgeSense Initiative website launch

Contributed technical support to make the organization more accessible to supporters, volunteers, and partners.

items.question: Who is K M Mubin?
items.answer: K M Mubin is a Data Science student and aspiring researcher from Dhaka, Bangladesh. He explores AI, NLP, LLMs, information retrieval, multilingual technology, and practical systems that create meaningful real-world impact.

items.question: What does K M Mubin work on?
items.answer: Mubin works on data analysis, machine learning, NLP, LLM evaluation, information retrieval, automation, visualization, and accessible technology. His projects connect research questions with usable applications.

items.answer: His research interests include low-resource language technology, multilingual benchmarking, ML interpretability, responsible AI, causal inference, AI for social good, and computational approaches to language and information.

items.question: Is K M Mubin open to research collaboration?
items.answer: Yes. Mubin is open to research collaborations, internships, student projects, and conversations about thoughtful, reproducible, and socially useful AI.
